sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:94

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:94:1
items.html: and its expansion is through the hairs of the upper head, for through it it expands into the thirty-two paths, etc. As explained in the adjacent item, that the whole preparation of ZA to receive the Hochma is through the Katnut [smallness/infancy] that he receives from the hairs of the Reisha [head], for by this his Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] was prepared to receive Mochin of AB. As written before us.
